rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿００１What? You want to stay here?!￥Do you understand what￥that means?＝＠１４０＿００２It means withdrawing as a￥candidate!＝...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿００３But... if that's your decision,￥so be it.＝＠１４０＿００４I'll see what I can do about￥getting you a job here.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿００５Looks like the two who qualified￥got off safely.＝＠１４０＿００６Staying behind... that was your￥call, so I won't say a word￥about it.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿００７A person should choose their own￥path in life.

＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿００８When someone you've looked after￥takes up the same work as you,￥it makes you proud. Happy, too.＝＠１４０＿００９It makes me as happy as if you'd￥qualified for Elan...＝＠１４０＿０１０No, maybe even happier...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１１Anyway, from now on￥you're staff here,￥same as me.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１２I'll be riding you harder than￥ever, so be ready!
